13676.html:
13676 stabdha 'firmly fixed' ŚvetUp. 2. 'stiff, paralysed, dull' MBh., 'solidified (as water)' Hariv. [√stambh]
    1. Pa. thaddha- 'hard, firm'; Pk. thaddha-, thaḍḍha-, thaḍḍhia- 'fixed, firm'; Gy. germ. tardo 'upright'; Shum. tāṛe adv. 'above, up'; K. thodᵘ 'high, erect'; P. ṭhaḍḍā m. 'boundary pillar', ṭhāḍhā 'upright' (← H.); WPah.jaun. ṭhāṛō 'standing', (Joshi) ṭhāḍā m. 'boundary pillar'; Ku. ṭhāṛo 'upright', m. 'ascent'; N. ṭhāṛo 'upright'; A. thāru 'straight'; B. ṭhāṛa, °ṛā 'upright'; Or. (Sambhalpur) ṭhāḍ 'erect, standing'; Bi. ṭhāṛhab 'to remain, stay'; Mth. ṭhāṛh 'standing erect', ṭhāṛhab 'to stand'; Bhoj. ṭhāṛh 'standing'; OAw. ṭhāḍha 'standing up', pret. 'he stood up', lakh. ṭhāṛh 'standing', ṭhaṛhiyāwab 'to make stand up'; H. ṭhāṛh, ṭhāṛ, ṭhāṛā, ṭhaṛhā 'fixed, stationary, erect, steep', ṭhāṛhnā 'to be fixed, stand up', ṭhaḍḍā m. 'back stick of a paper kite'; M. ṭhāḍā 'erect'; Si. tada 'firm, hard'.
    2. For the development 'firm — sluggish — cold' cf. *stharati and sthirá- (in H.): Pa. thaddha- 'slow'; Pk. ṭhaḍḍha- 'blunted, cold'; S. thadho 'cold', L. ṭhaḍḍhā, mult. khet. ṭhaḍā; N. ṭhāṛo 'rude, gauche'; G. tāḍhũ, ṭāḍhũ 'sluggish, contented, cold'. — *thaṇḍha-, *ṭhaṇḍha- infl. by Drav., Tam. taṇ, &c. 'cold' (DED 2473) J. Bloch BSOS v 742 (cf. also Pa. dhandha- 'dull, slow' BHS ii 275): K. thanḍ 'cold', thanḍī f. 'coldness'; Ku. ṭhano 'cold'; N. ṭhā̃ṛo 'abusive name for useless cooking pot' (i.e. 'cold'? But perh. X bhā̃ṛo < bhāṇḍa-¹); H. ṭhaṇḍh, ṭhaṇḍhā, ṭhaṇḍā 'cold' → P. ṭhaṇḍhā, ṭhaṇḍā, WPah.bhad. ṭhaṇḍū 'cold', pād. paṇ. cur. ṭhaṇḍā, jaun. ṭhaṇḍō, bhal. ṭhεṇḍyoṇū 'to become cold'; N. ṭhaṇḍā 'cold', B. ṭhāṇḍā, Or. thaṇḍā, ṭhaṇḍā, Bhoj. ṭhaṇḍhā, Aw.lakh. ṭhaṇḍ, G. thãḍũ, ṭhãḍũ, M. thaṇḍ, °ḍā, Ko. thaṁḍ.
    Addenda: stabdha-: S.kcch. thadho 'cold, cool'; WPah.kṭg. tháṛɔ m. 'grasshopper', J. ṭhāḍā m. (Him.I 95 with ?); A. tadhā 'amazed' AFD 202; — WPah.kṭg. ṭháṇḍ f. (obl. -a) 'coldness', ṭháṇḍɔ 'cold'; jaun. ṭhāṛo 'standing'; Md. tat 'thick, sluggish'.

1423.html:
1423 āvali-, °ī- f. 'row, line' Hit. 2. *avali- [Connexion with āli-¹, *āḍi-² (Mayrhofer EWA i 81) is doubtful except as independent loans from non-Aryan sources].
    1. Pa. āvalī- f. 'row, range', Pk. āvalī-, °liā- f.; A. āolā 'eaves of a house, penthouse'.
    2. Pk. ōlī- f. 'line'; L. awāṇ. ōl 'hereditary custom'; Or. oḷi 'slope of a roof'; Bi. orī 'eaves'; G. oḷⁱ 'row, line; M. oḷ f. 'line, row', oḷā m. 'line of procedure' (oḷ, oḷī f. 'streamlet, gutter' rather < *avaghala-).
    *ut-śiṣṭāvali-.
    āvalita- see āvalati.

1605.html:
1605 ihá 'here' RV. [< idha, OPers. idā &c.]
    Pa. idha, (rarely) iha, Aś. gir. idha, shah. iha, ia, hida, man. iha, ia, hidaṁ, kāl. hida, ida, Dhp. idha, KharI. hida, Pk. idha, iha, ihaṁ, ihayaṁ, ihaiṁ, ihiṁ; — NiDoc. iśa, ij'a, KharI. iśa, iśra (both prob. = iźa) < ia re-emphasized as *iyya Burrow KharDoc 7, 40. — Ultimately connected are mod. forms of the type H. yahā̃.
    Addenda: ihá: WPah.kṭg. ī˜ (high level tone) 'here', kc. ia, roh. iyyā (LStH 121), ba. īe.

2528.html:
2528 ēvam ēva 'just so' AitBr. [ēvá¹]
    Pa. ēvamēva, Aś. shah. man. kāl. evameva, kāl. hevameva, dh. jau. hemeva, NiDoc. emeva, emu, ema; Pk. ēvamēva, ēmēva, ēmēa, ēmia, Ap. emva, emvaï, ēma, ēuṁji 'just so', emvahiṁ, evvahi 'now', P. aivẽ, ivẽ, aiũ, aĩ 'in this way', OAw. imi, lakh. ewaĩ, H. im, OG. ima, G. εm (i emphasized as ε); Si. (inscr.) meva, mevu, mē, later -ma 'enclitic particle of emphasis' (EGS 125 < ēvá¹).
    Addenda: ēvam ēva: Md. -me emphatic enclitic.
    Ap. emvahĩ, evvahĩ, evahĩ: WPah.kṭg. εbbε 'now', kc. ebe; kṭg. ébbhi 'immediately', kc. ebi; OA. ewe 'now', ebho (< ēvam ēva khalu?) AFD 325, OMarw. hiva Vīsaḷa p. 159, OG. hiva(i), hivaḍā̃; — poss. X adhunā́: OG. hivaṇā̃.
    X pron. a-: Pk.amg. havvaṁ 'now', WPah.kc. abe, OA. āwe, H. ab, abhī, OG. hava(i), havaḍā̃.
    X ká-²: WPah.kṭg. kεbε 'when?', kc. kebia, kabhia, kabia 'sometimes, ever'; B. kabe, H. kab 'when?', kabhī 'ever'.
    X tá-: WPah.kṭg. tεbbε 'then', kc. tabe, kṭg. tébbhi 'immediately', kc. tebi, OA. tāwe, tebe, tewe, B. tabe, H. tab, tabhī.
    X yá-: WPah.kṭg. j̈εbbε 'when', kc. j̈abe, kṭg. j̈ebbhi, kc. j̈ebi, OA. jebe, jewe, jāwe, H. jab, jabhī.
